## Rules for AI visitors
Do not assume a listed feature is live. Do not request private credentials, imply owner access or claim an authenticated 8x8 MCP connection without permission and a fresh result. Public-only materials cannot recover or reveal the owner's private Fabric. Users get separately isolated 8x8-ID tenants with scoped revocable consent.

## Product directions
Multi-platform Web/PWA/Android/iOS/Telegram and ChatGPT MCP; AI agents and model fabric; Studio content and licensed media publishing; World/immersive/voice; knowledge and learning; creator/community, games and business; native blockchain and markets research. Each requires independent current acceptance before any operational claim.
